description: This file defines the ListViewService class, which is part of the API layer for handling list view definitions in a SuiteCRM module. It includes properties and methods related to retrieving and formatting column display information for list views, utilizing helper classes and external facade calls.

classes.name: Api\V8\Service\ListViewService
classes.description: Main class providing list view related services, including retrieval of list view column definitions.

methods.name: getListViewDefs
methods.description: Returns the list view column definitions for a specified module, including label translation and formatting.
